tutorial.heroSubtitle: Visual, short, and bilingual guide for Gujarat primary teachers to spot foundational gaps early, take 5-step remedial action, and verify student mastery.

aaravCase.step1Desc: Meet Aarav Patel, diagnosed with foundational division hurdles after scoring 35% on baseline diagnostic assessments.
aaravCase.step2Desc: Because 35% is strictly below the 60% mastery threshold, StudySaathi AI flagged an active gap requiring targeted intervention.
aaravCase.step3Desc: Teachers can quickly filter by class or search by name to track individual progress without paperwork.
aaravCase.step4Desc: Click to explore Aarav's 5-step concrete bean-counting remedial plan, practice activities, and +50 percentage-point recovery.

step1.title: Welcome to StudySaathi AI
step1.desc: Your offline-first companion designed for Gujarat primary teachers to spot foundational gaps early and deliver structured support.

step2.title: Classroom KPI Overview
step2.desc: Monitor enrolled students, see who needs support, track active 5-step plans, and measure verified score improvements.

step3.title: Immediate Attention Roster
step3.desc: Students scoring below 60% are flagged here immediately with their priority level and root-cause concept.

step4.title: Curriculum Proficiency Heatmap
step4.desc: Visual competency distribution across Math, Gujarati, and EVS. Instantly see which concepts need class-wide focus.

step5.title: Quick Sidebar Navigation
step5.desc: Easily switch between Student Rosters, Diagnostic Assessments, Learning Gaps, Remedial Plans, and Reports.

step6.title: Bilingual Language Switcher
step6.desc: Toggle between English and Gujarati anytime. Works 100% offline without reloading or losing your work.

step7.title: SaathiBot Pedagogical Assistant
step7.desc: Tap here anytime to ask pedagogical questions, get lesson recommendations, or trigger guided page walkthroughs.

step8.title: You're All Set!
step8.desc: Click below to open the sample case for Aarav Patel (Class 4) and see a complete 35% to 85% remedial recovery.

students.searchDesc: Quickly locate any student by typing their name or roll number. Works instantly with zero lag.
students.filterDesc: Filter your view between Class 3, 4, and 5 to focus on a single cohort.
students.tableDesc: See each student's current proficiency tag (Needs Support, Developing, Mastered) and recent assessment scores.
students.addDesc: Register a new student with basic details or import your whole class roster via simple CSV.

studentDetail.scoresDesc: Breakdown of baseline diagnostic scores across key foundational curriculum concepts.
studentDetail.reasonDesc: Clear explanation of why this gap occurred and the exact misconception blocking further progress.
studentDetail.planDesc: One-click generation of a structured concrete intervention plan using physical manipulatives.
studentDetail.reassessDesc: After completing the remedial steps, enter the re-test score here to celebrate objective percentage-point gain.

learningGaps.thresholdDesc: Any score strictly under 60% automatically flags a foundational learning gap requiring targeted support.
learningGaps.whyFlaggedDesc: Our offline engine details the exact developmental reasoning so you can tailor your classroom guidance.
learningGaps.actionPlanDesc: Jump straight into the targeted 5-step concrete plan tailored specifically for this student and concept.

remedialPlans.fiveStepsDesc: Starts with physical manipulatives (beads, counters) before advancing to visual diagrams and abstract symbols.
remedialPlans.markDoneDesc: Check off each intervention step as you teach it in class to monitor remedial progression.
remedialPlans.printDesc: Print clean, ink-friendly worksheets designed for rural Gujarat primary school desktop printers.

reports.cardDesc: Complete academic snapshot displaying initial gaps, completed interventions, and reassessment deltas.
reports.printDesc: Generate high-contrast parent-teacher progress sheets ready for sharing during parent meetings.

checklist.title: Get Started in 4 Steps
checklist.subtitle: Your quick teacher onboarding checklist
checklist.step1: Review your class overview & attention list
checklist.step2: Open a student who needs support (Aarav)
checklist.step4: Enter a re-test score & verify improvement (+pp)

help.masteryThresholdDesc: Scores below 60% trigger an automatic Learning Gap flag. 60-79% is Developing, and 80%+ marks Mastered.
help.gapDetectionDesc: Transparent deterministic rules compare diagnostic test results to curriculum learning outcomes.
help.deltaDesc: Absolute numerical score gain between the baseline diagnostic test and post-intervention reassessment.
help.remedialPlanDesc: Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract intervention structure starting with tactile objects (beads, counters).
